name: options_research_history
notes: This 117-symbol pool is the equity candidate universe for the live Algo selector and the options history collection universe.
The live Algo universe is the selector's eligible subset of this pool, recomputed each session.
XLRE was selected from the user's XLRE or VNQ alternative.

history_notes.CEG: Standalone CEG began regular-way trading on 2022-02-02 after its Exelon spin-off; do not use EXC as a historical alias.
history_notes.PLTR: Public trading began on 2020-09-30; options-history collection is configured from October 2020.
history_notes.COIN: Public trading began on 2021-04-14; collection starts with the April 2021 month.
history_notes.NU: IPO was on 2021-12-09; collection starts in January 2022.
history_notes.VRT: Vertiv began NYSE trading on 2020-02-10; its prior GSAH security was a SPAC, not Vertiv equity.
history_notes.GEV: GE Vernova began regular-way trading on 2024-04-02 after its GE spin-off; do not use GE as a historical alias.
history_notes.META: Facebook changed its ticker from FB to META on 2022-06-09.
history_notes.RTX: The continuing UTX common stock began trading as RTX on 2020-04-03; RTN was the merger partner, not the ticker predecessor.
history_notes.MSTR: The legal name changed from MicroStrategy to Strategy in 2025; the common-stock ticker remains MSTR.
history_notes.SPCX: This is SpaceX, not the unrelated fund that previously used SPCX; SpaceX began trading on 2026-06-12 and options-history collection starts 2026-06-16.
